parts.quote: Give me an overview of this week: what's on, the open tasks and the shopping list.

answers.text: This week includes Swim training on Tuesday, October 6, Early shift, Client meeting, Piano lesson, Football training, and Work dinner on Wednesday, October 7, Dentist checkup and Swimming on Thursday, October 8, and Sunday planning on Sunday, October 11. The open tasks are Buy a birthday present for Mila and Book the car service, and the shopping list is Groceries: Bread, Cheddar, Tomatoes, Pasta, Eggs.
